meta.title: Zephyr TV — the home screen for Android TV
meta.description: A light, open-source home screen for Android TV and Google TV: your apps, Continue Watching, films and series from Stremio add-ons, TV channels and a player, in nine languages.

footer.tmdb: Zephyr TV uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

home.hero_title: The home screen your Android TV deserves
home.hero_text: Zephyr TV is a light, open-source home screen for Android TV and Google TV: your apps, what you were watching, films and series, TV channels and a player, without ads.
home.f_home_text: Your apps in your order, Continue Watching from every app, a Spotlight of what's popular, and light, dark or glass themes.
home.f_watch_text: Catalogs from Cinemeta and Stremio add-ons, completed by TMDB, with pages for every title, season and episode.
home.f_addons_text: Stremio add-ons, Nuvio plugins and Zephyr TV extensions bring channels, films, series, radio and more.
home.f_player_text: Picks the best stream in your language and quality, with Dolby and DTS sound, Dolby Vision, subtitles from add-ons and the screen's frame rate.
home.f_users_text: Each person in the house has their own history, Continue Watching, avatar and Trakt account.
home.f_phone_text: Type on the phone, send add-ons and keys, back up and restore, or use it as a remote.

download.title: Download
download.intro: Zephyr TV installs on Android TV, Google TV and Android TV boxes (Android 7 or later). It updates itself from Settings → System → Updates.
download.none: The releases can't be read right now. Find them on
download.install_text: Download the APK on the TV with a browser or a file manager (or send it from a phone), allow installs from unknown sources when asked, then open it. In Settings, set Zephyr TV as the home screen.

credits.title: Projects and licences
credits.intro: Zephyr TV is free software. It is built on the work of other projects, and uses these libraries, services and media, each under its own licence.
credits.license_text: Zephyr TV is a modified version of Plume Launcher and, like it, is released under the GNU General Public License v3.0: you may use, modify and share it, and any version you distribute must be released under the GPL-3.0 with its full source code.

items.plume: The launcher Zephyr TV is built on: its design and most of its code.
items.piume: What Zephyr TV was before its new name; its history is in Zephyr TV's repository.
items.media3: The player: streams, HLS, DASH, RTSP and the like.
items.ffmpeg_decoder: Decodes the sound the device can't (Dolby, DTS, TrueHD), through FFmpeg.
items.ffmpeg: The audio decoders inside the FFmpeg extension.
items.wireguard: The tunnel for WARP, to hide Zephyr TV's address.
items.quickjs_kt: Runs the JavaScript of Nuvio plugins and extensions on the TV.
items.desugar: Newer Java features on older Android versions.
items.tmdb: Titles, posters, backdrops, cast and trending lists. Zephyr TV uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
items.trakt: History and progress of each user, synced with their Trakt account.
items.dicebear: The users' avatars, drawn by its API.
items.iptv_org: TV channel logos, for channels the TV has none for.
items.iptv_epg: The TV guide of each country.
items.stremio: The add-on protocol Zephyr TV speaks, and Cinemeta's free catalog.
items.nuvio: The plugin format Zephyr TV runs, as NuvioTV defines it.
items.paintings: The paintings of the screensaver, scans in the public domain.

login.title: Sign in
login.error_limited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.error_unverified: Confirm your email first: open the link we sent you.
login.error_invalid: Enter a valid email and your password.

admin.title: Admin
admin.soon: Zephyr TV users, TVs, sync and extensions come next.
admin.no_mail: Email isn't set up (SMTP_PASSWORD): new accounts can't confirm their email.

share.addon: A Stremio add-on for Zephyr TV
share.hint: Without Zephyr TV, get it, then open this link again.

trakt.ok_title: Done: Zephyr TV is signed in to Trakt
trakt.ok_text: Go back to the TV: it carries on by itself in a few seconds. You can close this page.
trakt.refused_text: Zephyr TV wasn't allowed on Trakt. Try again from the TV when you like.
trakt.error_text: The sign-in is too old or was already used. Start it again from the TV.

forms.limited: Too many tries. Wait a little and try again.
forms.pw_short: The password needs at least 10 characters.
forms.pw_long: The password can have at most 256 characters.
forms.pw_leaked: This password appears in leaked data breaches: choose another one.
forms.mail: The email couldn't be sent. Try again later.
forms.link_bad: This link is too old or was already used. Ask for a new one.
forms.email_taken: This email already has an account.
forms.superadmin: The superadmin's account can't be deleted here.

register.title: Create an account
register.intro: With an account you'll link your TVs, keep your Zephyr TV users in sync and publish extensions.
register.done: Almost done: open the link we sent to your email to confirm it. Check the spam folder too.
register.rules: At least 10 characters. Passwords found in data breaches aren't accepted.

resend.title: Confirmation email again
resend.intro: Enter your account's email: if it isn't confirmed yet, we'll send the link again.
resend.done: If the account exists and isn't confirmed, the link is on its way.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your account's email: we'll send a link to choose a new password, valid one hour.
forgot.done: If an account has this email, the link is on its way. Check the spam folder too.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.rules: At least 10 characters. Every device signed in to the account is signed out.

account.title: Your account
account.done_sessions: Signed out on the other devices.
account.language_text: The language of the emails we send you.
account.password_done: Password changed. The other devices were signed out.
account.email_text: We'll send a link to the new email: the account moves there once you open it.
account.email_done: Open the link we sent to the new email.
account.sessions_others: Sign out of the other devices
account.delete_text: Everything that belongs to the account goes, and can't be brought back.

email.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email.
email.verify_text: Confirm your email to start using your Zephyr TV account. The link works for {hours} hours.
email.reset_text: Choose a new password for your Zephyr TV account. The link works for {hours} hour.
email.change_text: Confirm this email to move your Zephyr TV account here. The link works for {hours} hours.

link.title: Link a TV
link.intro: Enter the code Zephyr TV shows in Settings → System → Zephyr TV account.
link.unknown: This code is unknown or too old: check it on the TV, or start again there.

users.title: Zephyr TV users
users.intro: The people who watch: each with their own avatar. On your linked TVs they come with sync.
users.name: Name
users.tvs_intro: The TVs signed in to this account. Unlink one and it signs out at once.
users.avatar_intro: Pick a style and an avatar: the first of each style is this user's, in that style.
users.dicebear: Avatars by DiceBear: only a random code goes to it, never a name.
